prompt: Create a new, small, complete DataEngLab course teaching pandas null-handling and deduplication basics for beginners (~90 minutes total, at least 50% practical, one practical lab).

assertions.name: course-spec-valid
assertions.text: course-spec.json exists, parses as JSON, and has all required fields

assertions.name: slug-matches-dir
assertions.text: course-spec.json's slug matches the output directory name

assertions.name: lessons-full-headings
assertions.text: every lesson has all 10 required ## headings, non-empty

assertions.name: quizzes-well-formed
assertions.text: every quiz question has Type, Difficulty, Related lesson, Question, Options, Correct answer, Explanation

assertions.name: instructor-separation
assertions.text: no solution code or instructor-only content under student-lab/

assertions.name: lab-execution-actually-run
assertions.text: a real lab-execution validator command was run with real pass/fail output quoted

assertions.name: review-actually-run
assertions.text: course-reviewer subagent was actually invoked and review-report.md has a PASS/FAIL verdict

assertions.name: elementor-exclusive-outcome
assertions.text: exactly one of landing-page.json or REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md exists; SOURCE.md present if tier 2

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.text: no fake statistics, testimonials, or unverifiable claims
